content.text: Where should the fold mark go on a shelf label?
Put the fold mark outside the trim line so it disappears when the label is cut.
A printer can finish a shelf label and then lose its acknowledgment. How should the queue handle a retry?
Maybe use the clock as a retry key. I am still comparing the options.
I've decided the queue will reuse the original print job ID on every retry. Record the reason and the next test.

The original print job ID lets the printer recognize a retry after a lost acknowledgment. A fresh ID makes the same label look like a new job. Next, drop the acknowledgment after printing and check that replay produces exactly one label.
How should we remind the operator to refill the ink?
Show the refill reminder after the active sheet finishes so it cannot interrupt a print.
